note: Cloudflare Web Analytics (ADR-0096). Modes: off (no script), auto (Cloudflare adds its script itself), manual (the build adds one script tag with webAnalyticsToken, 32 hex characters, public, the tag as Cloudflare's snippet gives it). Since 2026-11-14 the site is served through Cloudflare's proxy with a Transform Rule that sets Cache-Control to public, max-age=600, no-transform on every response: Cloudflare then adds NO script itself (neither the automatic analytics nor the bot-protection script), so the visit count runs in manual mode: the tag is in the page template, it measures every visitor (there is no option excluding the EU in manual mode; the author chose to measure everyone and say so on the privacy page). allowBotScript true would make the live check allow Cloudflare's bot script and the privacy words name it (false: the script is gone). excludeEu is only for auto mode. behindCloudflare tells the live check that a page it reads must have come through Cloudflare. The words follow the switches; the build and the live check refuse what they do not allow.
